Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

AgentGym: Evolving Large Language Model-based Agents across Diverse Environments (2406.04151v1) · paper method: For its main evolution experiments, AgentGym converts rewards below one to zero and retains reward one as success, even when an environment originally provides dense rewards.
